SELECT d.depot_id, d.full_name, COUNT(s.shipment_id) as shipment_count FROM drivers d JOIN shipments s ON s.driver_id = d.driver_id WHERE d.depot_id IN ('DEPOT-CENTRAL', 'DEPOT-HUB-2') AND s.dispatched_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY d.depot_id, d.full_name ORDER BY shipment_count DESC
